crypto_intro_1: Malo a cryptocurrency aphulika ndi ndalama zadigitala zikwizikwi ndi ntchito zosiyanasiyana.
crypto_intro_2: Pomwe Bitcoin ndiyo yoyamba ndipo ndiyodziwika kwambiri, imasiyana kwambiri ndi zinthu zina za crypto.
crypto_intro_3: Tiyeni tiwunikenso kusiyana kwakukulu pakati pa Bitcoin ndi cryptocurrency zina.
point_1_summary_1: Protocol ya Bitcoin yakhalabe yofanana kuyambira 2009, ndikupereka malamulo oyembekezereka. Ma project ambiri a crypto amasintha protocol, tokenomics, kapena amagawanika m'mabaibulo atsopano.
point_2_summary_1: Bitcoin imagwira ntchito pa makumi ambiri a node odziimira padziko lonse. Ma project ambiri a crypto amalamuliridwa ndi mabungwe, makampani, kapena ma dev gulu ang'ono omwe akhoza kupanga zosintha okha.
point_3_summary_1: Bitcoin ili ndi malire akhwawakhwa a 21 miliyoni — chuma cha digito chochepa kwambiri. Ma project ambiri a crypto ali ndi kuchuluka kopanda malire kapena njira zopangira ma token atsopano malingana ndi kufuna kwawo, kuchepetsa eni.
point_4_summary_1: Bitcoin ili ndi cholinga chimodzi: ndalama za digito za peer-to-peer. Aliyense akhoza kuyimvetsa ndi kuyigwiritsa ntchito. Crypto yambiri imaphatikizapo zopangidwa zophweka kapena DeFi yomwe imafuna luso lapadera kuti igwiritsidwe ntchito motetezeka.
point_5_summary_1: Proof of Work ya Bitcoin yakhala ikugwira ntchito popanda kuukira kopambana pa netiweki yaikulu kwa zaka 15 zoposa. Ma project ambiri a crypto amagwiritsa ntchito makonsensasi atsopano osayesedwa pamunda.
point_6_summary_1: Bitcoin ndi ndalama za digito — malo osungira phindu ndi njira yosinthana. Ma token ambiri a crypto ndi ma token oyendetsa kapena olamulira osakaza ndi mtengo wokayikitsa wa dziko lenileni.
point_7_summary_1: Bitcoin imakula yamphamvu pansi pa kuukira ndipo yapulumuka pa zovuta zonse, zoletsa, ndi kunyoza. Ma project ambiri a crypto amagwa pansi pa zovuta za malamulo, zaukadaulo, kapena za msika.
point_8_summary_1: Bitcoin ilibe CEO, ilibe kampani, ilibe malo amodzi olephera. Ma project ambiri a crypto amadalira ma VC, atsogoleri ena, kapena kupulumuka kwa kampani imodzi.
hero_title: Kusiyana pakati pa Bitcoin ndi Crypto
